title: Besicovitch–Federer for compact purely unrectifiable sets of finite measure, given Eilenberg's inequality (Dall'Alba, proof of Thm 5.1)
statement: Assume Eilenberg's inequality in the exact frozen form of the root-level node eilenberg_upper_integral_inequality (as in the sibling infinite_fibres). Then for all n ≥ 1, ℓ ≥ 1 and every compact, purely n-unrectifiable A ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} with Hⁿ(A) < ∞: for Lebesgue-a.e. v ∈ (ℝ^{n+ℓ})ⁿ, if v is linearly independent then Hⁿ(frameProjection v(A)) = 0, i.e. ForAlmostAllProjections (n+ℓ) n (fun p ↦ Hⁿ(p(A)) = 0).
lean_statement: (∀ (N m k : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ≥0, ∀ (A : Set (Rn N)) (f : Rn N → Rn m) (L : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith L f → ∃ g : Rn m → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g ∧ (∀ y, μHE[k] (A ∩ f ⁻¹' {y}) ≤ g y) ∧ ∫⁻ y, g y ≤ ((C * L ^ m : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) * μHE[m + k] A) → ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 0 < n → 0 < ℓ → ∀ A : Set (Rn (n + ℓ)), IsCompact A → PurelyUnrectifiable n A → μHE[n] A < ∞ → ForAlmostAllProjections (n + ℓ) n (fun p ↦ μHE[n] (p '' A) = 0)
